input_ref.x-reference-rule: Allow-listed scheme AND constrained body, identical to the CTR-IDM-001 result_ref rule. The earlier constraint was a deny-list, not:{pattern:"^https?://"}, which matched only a literal lowercase http(s) prefix. Independent security review, reproduced by WP-0A-CON-005 against the shipped schema, passed ALL of: HTTPS://public.example.invalid/x (uppercase scheme), //public.example.invalid/x (protocol-relative authority), ftp://public.example.invalid/x, data:text/plain;base64,AA==, file:///etc/passwd, javascript:alert(1) and ../../../etc/passwd. A scheme allow-list alone is also not enough: with a free body it would still pass result:../../../etc/passwd, status:/proc/self/environ, content:/.env and content://attacker.example.invalid/exfil. A leading slash, any `..` segment, an empty segment and an authority are all rejected. The scheme list is closed.
